root_causes.finding: The canonical CSV evaluator and early native runtime replay used different state, accounting, decision, and forced-end contracts.
root_causes.impact: A direct PnL comparison produced false deltas; the early native one-month replay was +101.5907% versus the corrected CSV baseline +338.6807%.

root_causes.finding: Alpha2.1 teacher is a 72-bar sequence model; latest-row-only inference can zero-pad the historical sequence and change decisions.
root_causes.impact: Parent/teacher accept-prune decisions can diverge from CSV canonical output.

root_causes.finding: Native mark/close paths could treat already-filled entry prices as raw prices and apply entry-side synthetic slippage again.
root_causes.impact: Stop/TP/max-hold timing and realized PnL diverged from canonical execution accounting.

root_causes.finding: V21.2 add-on gating used a different live adapter feature context than the CSV _feature_frame inputs.
root_causes.impact: Jackpot accept/reject timing and same-side resize counts could diverge.

root_causes.finding: CSV canonical forces remaining position at len(df)-1 after looping range(0, len(df)-2); native stop interpretation can force on a different bar.
root_causes.impact: Final action timestamp, final mark, and final PnL can differ.

root_causes.finding: After action parity, diagnostic rows still differed in close-row equity/realized display, cooldown labels, and UPSIZE reason labels.
root_causes.impact: First-diff tooling could point to logging noise instead of true behavioral divergence.
